$comment: Subscription forms (Codex / Grok subscription) go through the same truth -> projection path as every other form. inputCases: the subscription truth adapter yields the input verdict from the upstream proxy's own per-model declaration first (firstHand: list of declared input media, null = proxy declares nothing for this model), then modelFacts (models.dev input modalities, used only when firstHand is null), else unknown/catalog_silent. A firstHand list without the medium is unavailable/model_capability_absent; modelFacts without the medium is unknown (third-party fact is not hard evidence). The verdict then goes through the input projection table unchanged (endImplements false => disabled, wire not implemented). No end may answer a subscription input from providerKind attachment support or legacy model capability bits, and no end may return 'no projection' for subscription. reasoningLevelCases: levels = firstHand efforts when the proxy declares them, else modelFacts.reasoningEfforts, else []. Each end names its tests SUBSCRIPTION_FACTS_<id> (Web: it('SUBSCRIPTION-FACTS-<id> ...')). modelFactsLookupCases: the subscription adapter looks up modelFacts by model.id first, then by the metadata canonical model id (resolveMap); one lookup function feeds input, thinking, reasoning levels and tool_call on every end.
